title: Notification number status bar doesn't display when screen locked
body:
This started last night after installing the March security update on my Pixel 7 Pro.

Previously the BG value would display in the notification area whether locked or unlocked.  Now it only displays after unlocking.

comments.body: App Lock Screen setting is set to show all content.
I am having the same issue. Pixel 7, March update.

@michaeld427 Didn't you see a note asking you not to open an issue when you opened this?

We ask everyone to open a discussion instead of opening an issue.  And this is a link:  https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions

@Navid200 I see the note if I try to start a new issue right now, but I do not believe that came up for me when I posted the issue yesterday.  It is quite obvious what is showing there right now and you literally have to delete the example text from the box.  I would not have missed that.
